host.description: Hostname or unique identifier for this Magnum API node.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (use '-' to log to stdout).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

rpc_backend.description: Message queue backend for RPC communication (e.g., 'rabbit', 'kombu+sqlalchemy').

rabbit_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the RabbitMQ server.

rabbit_port.description: Port number of the RabbitMQ server.

rabbit_password.description: Password for RabbitMQ authentication (required if using RabbitMQ).

auth_uri.description: Public identity endpoint URL for end-user authentication (e.g., for Horizon).

auth_url.description: Internal (admin) identity endpoint URL for service-to-service auth.

keystone_authtoken_auth_type.description: Keystone auth method (usually 'password' for service accounts).

keystone_authtoken_project_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service project.

keystone_authtoken_user_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service user.

keystone_authtoken_username.description: Username for the Magnum service account in Keystone.

keystone_authtoken_password.description: Password for the Magnum service account (required).

keystone_authtoken_auth_url.description: Keystone admin endpoint URL for service auth (must include API version, e.g., /v3).

cluster_default_cooldown.description: Default cooldown period (in seconds) between cluster operations (e.g., scaling).

api_host.description: Network interface for Magnum API to bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

api_port.description: Port number for the Magnum API service.

api_enable_tls.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the Magnum API endpoint.

api_ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (only used if api_enable_tls is true).

api_ssl_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (only used if api_enable_tls is true).

trust_region_name.description: OpenStack region name where Magnum operates (used for trust delegation).

docker_insecure_registries.description: List of Docker registry hostnames (with optional ports) to treat as insecure (HTTP only).

docker_registry_mirror.description: Optional URL of a Docker registry mirror (e.g., 'https://mirror.example.com').

conductor_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the conductor service (parallel processing of cluster operations).

conductor_rpc_thread_pool_size.description: Size of the thread pool handling incoming RPC messages in the conductor.
